issuing_body: Minnesota Office of the Revisor of Statutes
title: Minn. Stat. § 611A.04, subd. 3 — Effect of Order for Restitution
supports: A restitution order may be enforced by a person named to receive restitution in the same manner as a judgment in a civil action.
A restitution order must be docketed as a civil judgment, and the court administrator must notify the commissioner of revenue of the restitution debt under the Revenue Recapture Act.
selected_locators: Subd. 3 — civil-judgment enforcement and docketing of restitution orders
important_qualifications: Civil judgment enforcement is a different legal mechanism from criminal or civil forfeiture under chapter 609.
